command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$change/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $change/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$change"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$change/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $change/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: handoff/README.md H1 section does not follow task 6.2: it lacks the required opening sentence "Apply `H1-glossary-track-end.patch` of the archived change `fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day` first; the command below does it when it is not applied yet.", and its Apply line is only `git apply openspec/changes/fix-day-track-drag-continuity-and-smoothness/handoff/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch` instead of the exact compound command `{ git apply --check --reverse …/H1-glossary-track-end.patch 2>/dev/null || git apply …/H1-glossary-track-end.patch; } && git apply --unidiff-zero …/H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch`; the task's check `grep -cE '^- \*\*Apply:\*\*.*H1-glossary-track-end\.patch.*H1-glossary-handle-drag\.patch'` would print 0, yet task 6.2 is ticked.

H1-glossary-handle-drag.patch was generated with 3 lines of context (hunk `@@ -3,8 +3,8 @@`), but task 6.2 requires a context-free patch (`git diff -U0`). Its context includes the 'Time selection … clamped to the reference day.' line, which the archived H1-glossary-track-end.patch rewrites to '… clamped between the start of the reference day and the track end', so in the required order (track-end patch first) this patch no longer applies and the task's scratch verification fails.

src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_drag_unit.steps.tsx is 218 lines; task 5.1 says 'If the steps file passes 200 lines, move helpers into `steps/dragSteps.ts`' and the tasks preamble says 'every file stays under 200 lines' (process-invariants: 'Target 100–200 lines per file'). The helper file is also named dragSteps.tsx, not the dragSteps.ts the task names.

time_selection_drag_e2e.feature uses 'the screen is 375 by 400 px' for 'A drag continues when the pointer leaves the track' and 'A drag past the right end pins the track end', but task 5.2 specifies 375 × 300 px, and its fallback when the points don't fit is to 'lower the offset here and in the spec scenario together', not to enlarge the viewport.

useDayTrackTouchFallback.ts:92-94 passes an inline `{ passive: true }` listener options literal while the non-passive option is a named constant (TRACK_TOUCH_MOVE_LISTENER_OPTIONS in constants/timeSelection.ts); code-style.md requires configuration values to live in src/constants ('Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant'), so a touchstart options constant belongs next to it.
